title: Veo can use an image as its first frame
summary:
Veo gained image-guided video generation, Enter shed a manual tier step, and Hello’s API calls got a single route.

Veo image-to-video requests now pass the supplied `image` to the model as a reference first frame. If a request includes multiple images, it uses the first.

New accounts are assigned the SPORE subscription automatically, replacing Enter’s manual Activate Tier button. The tier panel now explains pending setup, subscription syncing handles cancellations and revocations, and pending usage is counted across meter balances. A smaller pricing-page update clarifies that its Pollen estimate uses a seven-day community average.

NullVector, a Discord assistant that picks models based on the task, joined the socialBots listings. Community and documentation links were also aligned around one Discord invite.
